meta.name: doctorg
meta.description: Evidence-based health research using tiered trusted sources with GRADE-inspired evidence ratings. Integrates Apple Health data for personalized context. Use when user asks health, nutrition, exercise, sleep, or wellness questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询来自可信来源的健康研究与分级证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要基于证据的健康信息
copy.tagline_en: Get evidence-based health research from trusted sources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need evidence-based health information

howto.what: Claude 会使用可信的医学证据来回答健康问题，并对每条结论标注证据强度（如强、中等、弱等）。它还能读取 Apple Health 数据，为你提供个性化的健康建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出健康、营养、运动、睡眠或 wellness 相关的问题时，或者使用 /doctorg 命令时触发。

say.text: 每天走一万步有科学依据吗？
say.note: Claude 会快速搜索证据并给出强度评级。

say.text: 比较 Huberman 和 Attia 对空腹训练的看法。
say.note: 使用深度搜索模式，对比不同专家的观点。

say.text: 长期服用褪黑素安全吗？
say.note: 会进行全面调查，包括争议性证据。

howto.what_en: Claude answers health and wellness questions using trusted, evidence-based sources, rating each claim with evidence strength (Strong, Moderate, Weak, etc.). It can also integrate Apple Health data for personalized context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks health, nutrition, exercise, sleep, or wellness questions, or uses the /doctorg command.

say_en.text: Is 10,000 steps a day backed by science?
Compare Huberman and Attia on fasted training.
say_en.note: Deep research mode contrasts expert views.
